item.title: Design a small seed trial that answers a retail question
item.description: A demonstration sowing can be useful to a seed retailer, but only if the team knows what it is trying to learn. A tray of attractive seedlings is not automatically a variety trial, and a disappointing sowing does not by itself identify a seed problem

item.title: Review seasonal seed stock without confusing sales and demand
item.description: At the end of a seed-selling season, sales figures tell you what left the shelf. They do not automatically tell you everything customers wanted. An item may have sold slowly because the description was unclear, while another may have stopped selling
